preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer not exceeding the length of the input string s.
The output is the maximum number of characters that can be removed from s by optimally performing the allowed operations.
